Dialogs.Dialog: Takane
You know fruit punch？ Why is it called "punch," I wonder？
Ah, I've wondered that too. It's a strange name.
Right？ Why isn't it called fruit compote？
Com... pote？
At home we call it fruit compote...
Huh.
But at cafes, fruit compote is called fruit punch.
It's been bugging me lately. Do you wonder too？
Not really... I don't eat it much, so I don't know.
I see. Okay, I'll remember that.
(What's she going to use that for？)
Takane
Is there anything else you don't like, besides fruit punch？
I just don't eat it much. I don't dislike it.
Then, what do you like？
You can't eat me, can you.
I mean anything tastes good with ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
Geez... But I guess I'm the same. Except bitter coffee.
I'll put sugar in it for you. About ten dozen spoonfuls.
That's way too sweet.
Then I'll put salt in.
Geez, you're always saying silly things.
Takane
By the way, do you put salt in your coffee？
Huh？
What other unusual things do you drink？
I was joking... But I did drink chili sauce once, a long time ago.
Wow, amazing. You love chili sauce？
I didn't drink it because I liked it. I mistook it for tomato juice and chugged it...
Was it next to the tomato juice？ Same as Papa.
What do you mean？
Papa puts chili sauce in his tomato juice.
Huh, maybe I'll try that sometime.
Hehe, tell Papa what you think when you meet him someday？
For a surprising use of chili sauce, I tried it on canned mackerel.
Takane
How was it？
Actually, pretty good.
What did it taste like？
Like mackerel meuniere. It gave it a stronger tang.
So it worked like lemon, I guess.
Huh... Oh, now that you mention it, maybe so.
Hehe, try lemon next time？
...I'll do that.
Takane
Hey, you live alone, right？
Hm？ Yeah.
Are you keeping up with housework？
Well, more or less. I am... I think？
Really？
It's fine. I do, I do.
Then that's okay.
Do I seem that unreliable？
It's not that... I just can't help worrying.
(Is that how it is...)
Takane
Hey, about housework.
Ah, I'm keeping up, I said.
Cleaning too？ Do you keep your room clean？
I don't know if it's clean by ▲高嶺＊＊▲'s standards...
I knew it, I'm worried...
I think it's fine, though. I know where things are, and no cockroaches come out...
Eek！
Hmm？
N-Nothing...
(She hates them. Of course she does...)
Takane
Sorry if I'm being pushy？
Hm？
About the housework...
Ah, you're that worried？
What about laundry？
Sometimes I let it pile up...
Huh, you don't do it every day？
Almost... every day. It's just me, a guy, so it's not much.
Hmm...
(No need to worry so seriously...)
Takane
Hey, I was thinking...
About what？
Maybe I should help you with housework.
What, ▲高嶺＊＊▲!?
...You don't want me to？
It's not that I don't... but it's probably not a good idea. Besides, your parents would worry.
Why would Papa and Mama worry？
Why... I just bet they would.
If I really need it, I'll ask, so it's fine for now.
Okay... Then I'll save it as something to look forward to in the future？
(Is that... something to look forward to？)
Takane
...I need some advice about cooking fish.
Cooking... I don't know if I'll be any help. If that's okay.
Yes, thank you. I tried to fillet a fish, but...
Was it alive？
No, it's not that. The fish on the cutting board looked like it was glaring at me.
Ah, right. When you lock eyes with a fish at the supermarket, it's a little scary.
When I looked into its eyes, I just couldn't point the knife at it...
Close your eyes... No, that's dangerous.
What should I do？
That's not even a cooking problem. Hmm...
Hmm...
About the fish cooking you mentioned.
Takane
Yes.
So, you're scared of the fish's eyes？
Not the eyes themselves, it's like I can almost hear a voice...
A voice... The fish's？
"Who are you？" "What are you going to do to me？" ...That kind of voice.
You don't actually hear it, right？
Of course not. But doesn't that happen to you？ Even with stuffed animals.
I don't have any stuffed animals in my room...
Like my stuffed bunny might say "Welcome home," "Did anything fun happen？" That kind of feeling.
That's not scary, though.
Of course not.
About the fish cooking.
Takane
Yes, any good ideas？
Couldn't you have them cut the head off when you buy it？
Then it's not as fresh... and it doesn't solve the real problem.
What if you cook wearing sunglasses？ Then the fish eyes won't bother you.
Then I'd look weird.
Paint over the fish's eyes. Or use a marker.
That's a little cruel...
It's already dead.
Even so... That's not right.
Well, true...
About the fish problem.
Takane
Yes.
What if you hide the fish's eyes, like with a cloth？
I already tried that, but it still bothers me. Under this cloth, those eyes...
Then... All right！
What？
I'll scold it. Don't you complain at ▲高嶺＊＊▲！
...At the fish？
Yeah, don't scare a guy's girlfriend！
Poor fish, getting scolded... and then getting eaten.
...Right！
A little sad. But... yes.
I'll try cooking while thinking you're on my side. Then maybe I'll be okay.
Takane
There's something I'd like you to teach me.
What is it？
I often don't understand words everyone uses...
So sometimes I fall behind in conversations.
Ah, I see. Sure, if it's something I know.
Thank you. Then... What's "gachi"？
"Gachi" is...
How do you write it in kanji？
...Kanji？
Serious match, for real... I get the meaning, but I don't know the kanji.
"Gachi" is, um... "ga" as in "self," and "chi" as in "blood"... maybe？
I see！ Amazing, thank you.
...Sorry, ▲高嶺＊＊▲. That was a joke...
Takane
Um, there's another trendy word I don't get...
What kind？
What does "girl power" mean？
Well, ▲高嶺＊＊▲ has a lot of girl power.
My friends said that too, but is that a good thing？
Of course, since it's high.
Then, do you have a lot of boy power？
...Who knows. It's different from boyfriend power, huh.
Huh？
N-Nothing！
...Weird.
Takane
Hey. "Panee," what kind of person is that？
"Maji panee."
Yes, that person. I know what "maji" means. I think she's a real "Pa-nee-san."
I don't get "Pa-nee-san."
You don't have to laugh that much...
Sorry, sorry.
Could it be... it's not a person？
It might be a person.
Oh, so it is？
It might not be a person.
Huh... Oh, geez！ You're teasing me.
Haha.
Takane
There's another word I don't get. When do you use "diss"？
I don't want to get dissed by ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
"This-ed"？ Passive voice of "this"？ What does that mean...
No, no. Not that "this." D-I-S, "dis."
Ah, so it's something bad.
It's originally rapper slang, I think？
A trumpet player？ Is it a music term？
Um...
Did I... Again...
(Maybe this is one of ▲高嶺＊＊▲'s good points too.)
